capabilities: Create dictionary notes with a Words table and editable theory block
Review entries as flashcards scheduled with FSRS
Add and bulk-import words and edit fields inline
Show due-card stats and a vault-wide dashboard with tiles
Remind about due cards via start-up notices and a status-bar counter
disambiguation: Not limited to words: any column pair works as a flashcard, including images, audio, video, and color swatches.
extras: The repository ships an Agent Skill that teaches coding agents to create dictionaries without breaking the format; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced-repetition scheduling, so learning vocabulary or other paired facts means keeping content in a separate flashcard app.

relations.evidence: The Integrations section of the settings has Iconic icons, off until you turn it on.

summary: Turns markdown notes into spaced-repetition dictionaries with FSRS-scheduled flashcard review, stats, a vault dashboard, and due-card reminders.
